design_system: Use case: infographic-diagram. Asset type: one final portrait research-folio information page, 3:4 aspect ratio, high resolution. Primary request: clearly present the current Voynich investigation for a general reader. Style: polished restrained editorial information design, warm near-white background, dark ink text, muted teal for available evidence and amber for unresolved work, fine rules, generous margins. Match this design across all five pages. A strong short title, large legible sans-serif body text, compact serif title, clear reading order and aligned modules. All supplied text must be rendered verbatim, with accurate numbers and no invented copy. Keep the footer legible. Render the complete page with no cropping. Use only modest schematic diagrams that explain the information. Avoid parchment textures, botanical decoration, manuscript facsimiles, invented glyphs, fake handwriting, ornamental borders, tiny body text, gradients, shadows, 3D objects, or excessive giant numbers. Generated graphics explain reports; they are not manuscript evidence. Do not add illustrations of the manuscript. All content below is public repository research, not confidential material.

pages.prompt: Create page 01 of the five-page folio. A clear cover and project-status overview. Title text: "Voynich Manuscript Research". Subtitle: "The path from encoded text to a tested reading". Below title, a prominent goal panel with heading "The goal" and text "Explain the writing system and produce a source-linked English translation." Use a simple vertical five-stage route, each stage with a small stage number, clear title and one status line. Stage 1 title "Source records", line "Inventories, image references and pinned editions available." Stage 2 title "Exploratory constraints", line "Position, order and representation effects measured." Stage 3 title "Candidate rules", line "A leading-y lookup rule has an exploratory diagnostic." Stage 4 title "Evaluation on unseen material", line "A valid frozen evaluation set remains pending." Stage 5 title "Translation and reproduction", line "Supported readings and independent reproduction remain pending." Use teal markers for stages 1 and 2; amber for 3; open markers for 4 and 5. Do not show any stage as fully completed or validated. Strong callout near the bottom: "No validated decipherment or translation yet." Small navigation row: "02 Evidence  /  03 Transcription  /  04 Findings  /  05 Next tests". Footer text: "Snapshot: 12 October 2026 · main 1c74085" and page number "01 / 05". Keep all five stages, status and goal visible with ample spacing.

Create page 02 of the five-page folio with title "What the evidence covers" and subtitle "Count the unit before interpreting the number". Top: three equally sized metric modules, without oversized numbers: "10 selected pilot sides" with "Across six catalog groups"; "213 Yale scan views" with "Digitized images in the pinned index"; "204 numbered side labels" with "Explicit labels, not verified text mappings". Middle: a three-row definition table headed "Three different units". Row labels and text: "Scan view" / "One digitized image; it can contain several panels."; "Folio side" / "One manuscript surface, such as 76r."; "Native locus" / "One text location in a transcription edition." Below, a section "Pilot linking status" with two clear side-by-side blocks: "7 / 10" / "Exact page metadata links" / "These still need image and glyph review." and "3 / 10" / "Mapping gaps remain" / "67r, 68r and the shared 85v/86r scan." Then text "Provisional panel and region records add context; they do not pass the pilot readiness gate." Bottom amber callout: "Shared scans and overlapping samples are shared evidence." Footer: "Sources: pilot readiness · Yale image index" and "12 October 2026 · main 1c74085" and page number "02 / 05". Use clear definitions, neutral schematic boxes, no manuscript illustration, no misleading proportion chart.

Create page 03 of the five-page folio. Title "A transcription is a representation". Subtitle "Source agreement does not settle word boundaries". Top paired source panels: "ZL3b" with "Working source: retains spacing and reading alternatives"; "IT2a" with "Paired comparison: preserve its separate conventions". A short line below: "These editions are related evidence, not independent experiments." Three simple decision rows: "Edition" / "Pin the exact version and alphabet."; "Uncertain spaces" / "Compare splitting with joining."; "Ambiguous readings" / "Retain exclusions and alternative treatments." Lower half: clearly grouped boundary-audit module with heading "Same encoded text, different divisions". Text "2,940 common eligible P0 loci" and "2,054 have identical concatenated strings." Within this module, a two-row mini-table headed "Boundary disagreements within those 2,054": "Split spacing" / "562 loci"; "Joined spacing" / "767 loci". Beneath table: "The two counts overlap; do not add them." Strong bottom callout: "Encoded characters and tokens are not verified glyphs or words." Footer: "Sources: transcription decision · token-boundary concordance" and "12 October 2026 · main 1c74085" and "03 / 05". No glyph samples, fabricated transcription or invented word examples.

Create page 04 of the five-page folio. Title "What the tests show". Subtitle "Exploratory results, with their limits kept beside them". Main layout: four generously spaced horizontal modules, each with a clear label, a result line and a short implication. All text below verbatim. Module 1 label "Immediate repetition", result "272 observed equal adjacent pairs; 270.77 expected.", context "Primary ZL split/exclude; 3,884 shared P0 candidates.", implication "No clear excess under this conditional control." Module 2 label "Interior length order", result "All four treatments exceed 999 half-constrained controls.", context "Common cohort: 2,165 encoded loci.", implication "Independent positional gradients can also create a positive departure." Module 3 label "Previous-length prediction", result "The exact-slot model loses on every fold in all four treatments.", implication "This fixed model fails its stated preference criterion." Module 4 label "Leading-y lookup candidate", result "Primary selectivity: +0.3923 → +0.1064 after matching.", context "Same 13 units; match development frequency and length.", implication "A positive string-lookup contrast remains; glyph function is unresolved." Avoid plotting these incompatible quantities on one axis. Show no manuscript illustration. Use typographic modules with small understated category markers and distinct result/limit line treatments. Bottom amber callout: "Previously exposed data: these tests do not establish a language or translation." Footer: "Sources: repetition · interior controls · exact-slot model · y-specificity" and "12 October 2026 · main 1c74085" and "04 / 05". Every module must fit without tiny text or clipped edges.

Create page 05 of the five-page folio. Title "What needs to happen next". Subtitle "Turn exploratory constraints into a testable reading". Top compact panel labelled "Available now" with text "Pinned sources, reproducible reports, provisional image regions and local review tools." Main layout: a vertical five-step sequence, each with its number, a verb-led heading and one deliverable. Step 1 heading "Review the images", text "Adjudicate complete rows, glyphs and divisions; resolve pilot panel mappings." Step 2 heading "Define valid evaluation material", text "Declare prior exposure and shared-scan dependencies before freezing a split." Step 3 heading "Freeze the candidate", text "Record complete rules, predictions, controls and failure conditions." Step 4 heading "Test without retuning", text "Report every outcome, contradiction and exclusion on the reserved material." Step 5 heading "Reproduce and translate", text "Publish supported passages with source links, derivation and unresolved alternatives." Small unresolved-item panel near bottom: "Open issue #13" and "Legacy 117v versus current 116v labels still need a verified correspondence." Strong bottom callout: "An 8/2 pilot split is a proposal, not an established unseen test set." Footer: "Sources: evaluation protocol · pilot readiness · issue #13" and "12 October 2026 · main 1c74085" and "05 / 05". Keep readable spacing and all five deliverables visible. No checkmarks implying the pending steps are completed.
